title: Tech Note: Building Applications Examples – Part 4 Versioning
author: Josh Fletcher, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: Part of a well-documented five-part series on 4D's XML-based build configuration system from the mid-2000s; while the specific 80+ key XML format described here (4D 2004 era) has been superseded, the general idea of declarative, versioned build configuration persists in modern 4D's build/compile settings.
related_updates: 4D's application build and versioning configuration has been substantially modernized in later 4D versions, moving away from this specific XML-key project-file format
Project Mode (2018+) introduced a fully text-based, git-friendly project structure that further changed how build settings are stored and versioned
